title: 黄仁勋卸任英伟达CEO内幕：董事会与个人风波
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Whatever, I don't care and worse, these are unusual words for an individual that we usually see being very direct, full of energy, charismatic, a take charge kind of guy.
segments.zh: 无所谓，我不在乎，更糟的是，这些话通常不会出自一个我们印象中非常直接、精力充沛、魅力十足、掌控全局的人之口。

segments.en: What led to the giving up of Jensen Wong? Because you guys, you do some incredible reporting here.
segments.zh: 是什么导致黄仁勋放弃？因为你们做了非常出色的报道。

segments.en: I mean the situation that he put himself in and the situation that the board was forced to deal with was such that there was no choice.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，他让自己陷入的处境，以及董事会被迫应对的局面，使得他们别无选择。

segments.en: There were of course rumors and speculation and an admission of an affair with somebody who was at a customer, but then when you factor in an affair with somebody who actually works for the company, something that is explicitly not permissible.
segments.zh: 当然有传言和猜测，还有他承认与一位客户方人员有婚外情，但随后又牵扯出与公司内部员工的婚外情，这是明确不允许的。

segments.en: Not permissible under the company's stated rules, then the board were in a position where they had no choice but to bring this to him and that he had no choice there was no way around this.
segments.zh: 根据公司明文规定，这是不允许的，于是董事会别无选择，只能向他提出此事，他也别无选择，无法回避。

segments.en: Can you describe, and you do it so well in the piece that you wrote with Drake Bennett, the Jensen Wong that emerged in the last few days, behind closed doors, the discussions that he had with confidants, with members of the board, his demeanor, the way he was talking,
segments.zh: 你能描述一下——你在与德雷克·贝内特合写的文章中写得很好——过去几天闭门背后浮现的黄仁勋，他与亲信、董事会成员的讨论，他的举止，他说话的方式，

segments.en: versus the Jensen Wong that for so many years you covered as this person who became known as the central banker of the AI industry.
segments.zh: 与你们多年来报道的那个被称为AI行业中央银行的黄仁勋相比。
